PathOfBuilding.Notes:
Before you start with your Templar, make a Ranger character. Kill Hillock, get to town and stash your Momentum Support. Then, do the "Mercy Mission" Quest and grab a Quicksilver Flask + Volley Support. Then, put all your items in your stash, delete this character and start your normal Templar run.
If you have a good staff, use Flame Dash instead of Shield Charge. Tradeoff: You'll be slower.
